terminals.name: e2e-stack
terminals.command: make e2e-env-up && echo 'E2E stack is healthy' && cd e2e/playwright && docker compose --profile fake logs -f --tail 0
terminals.description: Boots the E2E stack from e2e/playwright/docker-compose.yml: Mattermost at http://localhost:8075, Postgres on 5434, and a fake Google (e2e/playwright/fake-google, control API at http://127.0.0.1:8090) that answers for Google's hostnames inside the stack. Wait for 'E2E stack is healthy' before running tests. Run the suite with `make e2e` from the repo root (rebuilds the plugin), or `cd e2e/playwright && npm test` after `make dist`. Filter with `npx playwright test specs/<spec>.spec.ts`. Reset all data with `make e2e-env-down && make e2e-env-up`. The Mattermost admin is sysadmin / Sys@dmin-sample1. Only the fake-Google lane works here: there are no real Google credentials, so do not run `E2E_GOOGLE=real` or `npm run test:real`, and do not try to connect an account by hand in a browser (only the suite's Chromium routes accounts.google.com to the fake; seed connected users with lib/google/auth.ts seedConnectedGoogleUser instead). The visual specs (@visual, script/visual.sh) need a second stack and are not set up here.
